hero.name: Shir Zabolotny
hero.sub: We build software with careful decisions, from architecture to interface details, so products stay clear, maintainable, and natural to use.

about.label: About
paragraphs: With a Masters in Information Systems and experience in tech companies, I shaped my skills around building things that hold up in real systems.
What truly guides my work is a **visual and intuitive sense**, how things should look, behave, and feel. I have an artistic eye, and I naturally notice composition, balance, and flow.

I like going deep into systems, understanding **how everything connects**, so decisions made early do not turn into friction later. I am also **easy to work with**: I ask questions, I listen, and I care about making things clear.

ai.label: AI perspective
ai.introText: AI is powerful. It writes code fast, builds components, and solves problems in seconds. We use it too.
ai.introSub: But speed isn't the same as direction.

pillars.title: Continuity
pillars.text: Great products feel like one mind built them. Same logic. Same tone. Same patterns.

pillars.title: Anticipation
pillars.text: Users don't follow perfect paths. They hesitate, get confused, hit edge cases.
items: A professional **sees** problems before they happen

pillars.title: Intent
pillars.text: AI assembles what looks right. A professional builds what feels right.
items: But decisions that serve a clear **purpose**

ai.footerText: AI saves time. A professional makes sure time is spent on the **right** thing.
